headline: Russian Oligarchs Demand Millions from Poland. Seized Factory in the Background
summary: Russian owners of a Lower Silesian factory are demanding nearly PLN 500m from Poland after sanctions led to the plant passing to a new investor. The Moscow court hearing was postponed to April 2027.
why: Sanctions-related asset disputes create legal and financial risks for investors in the affected companies and for the state seeking to defend its actions.
original_headline: Rosyjscy oligarchowie żądają milionów od Polski. W tle przejęta fabryka
